title: Tighten intra-component flow detection precision (47 FPs at 1 TP)
description: PR #66 landed the intra-component lineage detector: data-flows recall 0->1/158, precision 1/48 (47 false positives). Tighten emission to reduce FPs while keeping the 1 TP (pocketbase-password-to-bcrypt-hash) and not regressing other layers. Investigate the 47 FPs by repo (ghost 10, pocketbase 7, directus/keycloak/posthog-user/saleor/strapi 4 each, etc.). Likely candidates: pattern specificity, dedupe, disposition gating. Measure against the pinned baseline; recall must not drop below 1/158, precision should rise. Do not change gold.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope expanded per manager plan: widen intra-component detection to all 158 gold flows + tighten the 47 FPs in one slice. Two levers: (1) add 8 pattern groups + 2 systemic regex fixes, (2) teach component resolution for webapi.xml, routes.rb, modules/*.ts, Rails models. Target recall 1/158 -> 40+, precision holds. Dispatching implementer.

comments.text: PR #67 opened. Recall 0->4/158 (good) but precision cratered: 246 findings, 242 FPs. Send-back: keep the 4 TPs, cut the 246 denominator dramatically. Big gain (40+) blocked on components layer (next slice). Tighten to mergeable precision, then merge the small gain.
